items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: Johnny Provincana played pretty good client there. You never did hear Johnny.

ctx.x: Did your sister ever make any records by the way? Lucille you mean? Yes.

Yeah, Bernie, no. You see, the first time when I was working out of the Bugtown, Leon Rapport was playing out there, and George E. Brunus, Joe Gowler was playing piano, myself. We used to have corner players. We never had any corner players. We used to have corner players just come in and sit in, you know, like Johnny Lala, Manny Blessie, Paul Merez, and a few guys. We only had trombone, clown and piano and drums, you know. That was one of the jobs, I mean, they really, it was supposed to be a union job and they…
